messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Analyzing PA intensity classification
parts:
Hi Khai,

Estimating time spent in MVPA is one of the big mysteries in physical activity research.
For threshold selection there is some guidance in the literature, but more difficult is the decision on how to define a MVPA bout and how to mathematically allow for gaps in bouts when the epochs are shorter than 1 minute.
There is no gold standard for this, by which any approach could in theory be the 'right' one. It is then all down to your interpretation of the estimates.

You may want to read papers that have used the MVPA estimates, e.g. da Silva in IJE 2014 and Menai in Sci Rep 2017. Further, the GGIR documentation should clarify what all the variables mean.

Vincent
